classdef.name: AnchorPoint
classdef.shortdesc: The reference point on the object's bounding box that does not move during transformation operations. Note: Transformations include rotation, scaling, flipping, and shearing.

property.name: TOP_CENTER_ANCHOR
property.shortdesc: The center point on the top of the bounding box.

property.name: LEFT_CENTER_ANCHOR
property.shortdesc: The center point on the left side of the bounding box.

property.name: CENTER_ANCHOR
property.shortdesc: The center point in the bounding box.

property.name: RIGHT_CENTER_ANCHOR
property.shortdesc: The center point on the right side of the bounding box.

property.name: BOTTOM_CENTER_ANCHOR
property.shortdesc: The center point on the bottom of the bounding box.
